name: f-create
js: (()=>{const P=[["Gabriele", "Anna"]],E=[];let n=0;const w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);let x;while(x=w.nextNode()){let v=x.nodeValue,o=v;for(const [a,b] of P)v=v.split(a).join(b);const t=v.trim();for(const [a,b] of E)if(t===a)v=v.replace(a,b);if(v!==o){x.nodeValue=v;n++}}document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea').forEach(i=>{for(const [a,b] of P)if(i.value)i.value=i.value.split(a).join(b)});return 'swapped '+n})()
